sentences.zh: 九年六月，有桑生於宮西廂，日長尺餘，數日而枯。

translations.literal: In the sixth lunar month of the ninth year, a mulberry sprouted in the west wing of the palace; it grew more than a chi each day and withered after several days.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth lunar month of the ninth year, a mulberry sprouted in the palace’s west wing. It grew more than a chi each day, then withered after several days.

sentences.zh: 十二月，賈后將廢太子，詐稱上不和，呼太子入朝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, when Empress Jia would depose the crown prince, she falsely claimed the emperor was unwell and summoned the crown prince to court.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month Jia feigned imperial illness to lure Yu to court.

sentences.zh: 既至，後不見，置於別室，遣婢陳舞賜以酒棗，逼飲醉之。

translations.literal: When he arrived she did not receive him but lodged him in a side chamber, sent maid Chen Wu with ale and jujubes, and forced him drunk.
translations.idiomatic: She hid him, fed him wine and dates through Chen Wu until he was drunk.

sentences.zh: 使黃門侍郎潘岳作書草，若禱神之文，有如太子素意，因醉而書之，令小婢承福以紙筆及書草使太子書之。

translations.literal: She had Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Pan Yue draft a prayer text mimicking the crown prince's usual intent; because he was drunk she made him copy it, having the young maid Chengfu bring paper, brush, and draft.
translations.idiomatic: She had Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Pan Yue draft a prayer text mimicking the Crown Prince's usual intent; because he was drunk she made him copy it, having the young maid Chengfu bring paper, brush, and draft.

sentences.zh: 文曰：「陛下宜自了；

translations.literal: The text read: "Your Majesty should end your own life;
translations.idiomatic: The text read: "Your Majesty should end your own life;

sentences.zh: 不自了，吾當入了之。

translations.literal: if you do not end it yourself, I shall come in and end it for you.
translations.idiomatic: Or I will finish you.

sentences.zh: 中宮又宜速自了；

translations.literal: The empress too should quickly end her own life;
translations.idiomatic: The empress too should quickly end her own life;

sentences.zh: 不了，吾當手了之。

translations.literal: if she does not, I shall end her life with my own hands.
translations.idiomatic: Or I will kill her myself.

sentences.zh: 並謝妃共要克期而兩發，勿疑猶豫，致後患。

translations.literal: Together with Consort Xie we agreed a joint date for simultaneous rising—do not hesitate and breed later trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Xie and I strike together—no delay.

sentences.zh: 茹毛飲血於三辰之下，皇天許當掃除患害，立道文為王，蔣為內主。

translations.literal: We shall eat raw flesh and drink blood beneath the three luminaries; High Heaven grants us leave to sweep away the scourge, enthrone Daowen as king, and install Jiang as inner mistress.
translations.idiomatic: We shall eat raw flesh and drink blood beneath the three luminaries; High Heaven grants us leave to sweep away the scourge, enthrone Daowen as king, and install Jiang as inner mistress.

sentences.zh: 願成，當三牲祠北君，大赦天下。

translations.literal: When wish is fulfilled we shall sacrifice three victims to the Northern Lord and proclaim an empire-wide amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Then sacrifice to the Northern Lord and amnesty all.

sentences.zh: 要疏如律令。」

translations.literal: Let this sworn petition take effect as commanded.
translations.idiomatic: So commands the spell.'

sentences.zh: 太子醉迷不覺，遂依而寫之，其字半不成。

translations.literal: The crown prince was too drunk and confused to notice; he copied accordingly; half the characters failed to form.
translations.idiomatic: Too drunk and confused to realize what he was doing, the crown prince copied it, but half the characters were incomplete.

sentences.zh: 既而補成之，后以呈帝。

translations.literal: They afterward filled them in; the empress presented it to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Helpers patched characters before Jia showed Hui.

sentences.zh: 帝幸式乾殿，召公卿入，使黃門令董猛乙太子書及青紙詔曰：「遹書如此，今賜死。」

translations.literal: The emperor visited Shi-Qian Hall, summoned dukes and ministers, and had Yellow Gate Chief Dong Meng display the crown prince's script with an edict on blue paper: 'Yu has written thus—now sentence him to death.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor visited Shi-Qian Hall, summoned dukes and ministers, and had Yellow Gate Chief Dong Meng display the crown prince's script with an edict on blue paper: "Yu has written thus—now sentence him to death."

sentences.zh: 遍示諸公王，莫有言者，惟張華、裴頠證明太子。

translations.literal: No one among lords and dukes spoke except Zhang Hua and Pei Wei who verified the crown prince's innocence.
translations.idiomatic: Silence fell until Zhang Hua and Pei Wei defended Yu.

sentences.zh: 賈后使董猛矯以長廣公主辭白帝曰：「事宜速決，而群臣各有不同，若有不從詔，宜以軍法從事。」

translations.literal: Empress Jia had Dong Meng falsely relay Princess Changguang's words to the emperor: 'Matters must be settled quickly while ministers disagree—whoever disobeys the edict should face military law.'
translations.idiomatic: Empress Jia had Dong Meng falsely relay Princess Changguang's words to the emperor: "Matters must be settled quickly while ministers disagree—whoever disobeys the edict should face military law."

sentences.zh: 議至日西不決。

translations.literal: Deliberation lasted until sunset unresolved.
translations.idiomatic: Debate stalled till dusk.

sentences.zh: 後懼事變，乃表免太子為庶人，詔許之。

translations.literal: The empress feared events might shift and therefore memorialized to degrade the crown prince to commoner status; an edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: Jia feared delay—demoted Yu to commoner instead.

sentences.zh: 於是使尚書和郁持節，解結為副，及大將軍梁王肜、鎮東將軍淮南王允、前將軍東武公澹、趙王倫、太保何劭詣東宮，廢太子為庶人。

translations.literal: Thereupon Minister He Yu was dispatched with insignia, with Xie Jie as deputy, together with General-in-Chief Sima Rong, Prince of Liang; Eastern Garrison General Sima Yun, Prince of Huainan; Forward General Sima Dan, Duke of Dongwu; Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao; and Grand Guardian He Shao. They went to the Eastern Palace to depose the crown prince as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Minister He Yu was dispatched with insignia, with Xie Jie as deputy, together with General-in-Chief Sima Rong, Prince of Liang; Eastern Garrison General Sima Yun, Prince of Huainan; Forward General Sima Dan, Duke of Dongwu; Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao; and Grand Guardian He Shao. They went to the Eastern Palace to depose the crown prince as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 是日太子游玄圃，聞有使者至，改服出崇賢門，再拜受詔，步出承華門，乘粗犢車。

translations.literal: That day the crown prince roamed the Mystic Garden; hearing envoys arrived he changed clothes, exited Chongxian Gate, twice bowed receiving the edict, walked out Chenghua Gate, and rode a rough ox-cart.
translations.idiomatic: That day the crown prince roamed the Mystic Garden; hearing envoys arrived he changed clothes, exited Chongxian Gate, twice bowed receiving the edict, walked out Chenghua Gate, and rode a rough ox-cart.

sentences.zh: 澹以兵仗送太子妃王氏、三皇孫于金墉城，考竟謝淑妃及太子保林蔣俊。

translations.literal: Dan escorted Crown Princess Wang and the three imperial grandsons to Jinyong under armed guard, and interrogated Consort Xie and the crown prince’s Lady Baolin Jiang Jun to death.
translations.idiomatic: Dan escorted Crown Princess Wang and the three imperial grandsons to Jinyong under armed guard, and interrogated Consort Xie and the crown prince’s Lady Baolin Jiang Jun to death.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，賈后又使黃門自首，欲與太子為逆。

translations.literal: The next first month Empress Jia again had a Yellow Gate confess plotting rebellion with the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Next New Year Jia staged a Yellow Gate confession implicating Yu.

sentences.zh: 詔以黃門首辭班示公卿。

translations.literal: An edict circulated the confession among dukes and ministers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict circulated the Yellow Gate eunuch’s confession among the dukes and ministers.

sentences.zh: 又遣澹以千兵防送太子，更幽于許昌宮之別坊，令治書御史劉振持節守之。

translations.literal: She further sent Dan with a thousand troops to escort the crown prince, moving him to a separate compound of Xuchang palace under Supervising Secretary Liu Zhen with insignia.
translations.idiomatic: She further sent Dan with a thousand troops to escort the crown prince, moving him to a separate compound of Xuchang palace under Supervising Secretary Liu Zhen with insignia.

sentences.zh: 先是，有童謠曰：「東宮馬子莫聾空，前至臘月纏汝閤。」

translations.literal: Earlier a children's rhyme ran: 'Eastern Palace foals—don't plug your ears empty; come twelfth month they'll twine your chamber.'
translations.idiomatic: Earlier a children's rhyme ran: "Eastern Palace foals—don't plug your ears empty; come twelfth month they'll twine your chamber."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「南風起兮吹白沙，遙望魯國郁嵯峨，千歲髑髏生齒牙。」

translations.literal: Another went: 'South wind rises blowing white sand; far off Lu kingdom gloomy and tall; thousand-year skulls sprout teeth.'
translations.idiomatic: Another went: 'South wind rises blowing white sand; far off Lu kingdom gloomy and tall; thousand-year skulls sprout teeth.'

sentences.zh: 南風，后名；

translations.literal: South Wind' was the empress's name.
translations.idiomatic: South Wind' meant Empress Jia.

sentences.zh: 沙門，太子小字也。

translations.literal: 'Shamen' was the crown prince's childhood byname.
translations.idiomatic: 'Shamen' was the crown prince's childhood byname.
